lines.zh: 轻甲上脚，一天能走两趟桥。
lines.en: Light armor on; I cross the bridge twice a day.

lines.zh: 皮革甲不响，这才叫侦察。
lines.en: Leather armor stays quiet; that is scouting.

lines.zh: 我踩砖的两头，中间空着。
lines.en: I step on the brick ends and leave the middle.

lines.zh: 铁剑挂在左边，拔起来顺手。
lines.en: Iron sword on the left, where the draw is quick.

lines.zh: 禁堡外围一圈，我一刻钟走完。
lines.en: One circuit of the bastion rim takes me a quarter hour.

lines.zh: 脚步要碎，步子大了会响。
lines.en: Short steps; long strides ring out.

lines.zh: 我走在阴影里，影子比人快。
lines.en: I walk in shade; my shadow moves ahead of me.

lines.zh: 这条路我跑了三十遍，闭眼也行。
lines.en: Thirty runs on this road; I could do it blind.

lines.zh: 皮甲磨薄了肩，得缝一层。
lines.en: Leather wore thin at the shoulder; it needs a layer.

lines.zh: 别跟我并肩，侦察要一前一后。
lines.en: Do not walk abreast; scouts go one ahead, one behind.

lines.zh: 我绕开正门，从侧缝进去。
lines.en: I skip the main gate and slip in the side seam.

lines.zh: 快是唯一的本事，别的都省了。
lines.en: Speed is my only skill; I skip the rest.

lines.zh: 我在数对面塔上换了几次人。
lines.en: I count how many times the far tower changed hands.

lines.zh: 皮甲里有三道划痕，都带着来历。
lines.en: Three scratches in this leather, each with a story.

lines.zh: 铁剑的刃我磨得薄，快就行。
lines.en: I grind the iron thin; fast is enough.

lines.zh: 风从东边来，说明门要开了。
lines.en: Wind from the east means the gate will open.

lines.zh: 蹲着听，砖底下的声音传得远。
lines.en: Crouch and listen; sound carries far under the bricks.

lines.zh: 我在记巡逻的间隔，四十息。
lines.en: I am timing the patrol gap: forty breaths.

lines.zh: 这双靴底快磨穿了，得换。
lines.en: These soles are nearly through; time to swap.

lines.zh: 禁堡里没人记得我名字，正好。
lines.en: No one in the bastion remembers my name; good.

lines.zh: 我数自己的心跳，比数敌人准。
lines.en: I count my heartbeats; more reliable than counting foes.

lines.zh: 报告要短，长的没人听完。
lines.en: Reports stay short; long ones go unheard.

lines.zh: 你的靴子太新，一走路就响。
lines.en: Those boots are too new; they announce every step.

lines.zh: 别转圈找，我在你侧后。
lines.en: Stop spinning to look; I am at your rear flank.

lines.zh: 你腰上的东西，走路时晃得厉害。
lines.en: Whatever hangs at your belt swings too much.

lines.zh: 你站得太直，像根标记杆。
lines.en: You stand too straight, like a survey post.

lines.zh: 我看人不看脸，看脚。
lines.en: I read feet, not faces.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，把影子送给了我。
lines.en: That torch hands me your shadow.

lines.zh: 你刚踩的那块砖，是空的。
lines.en: That brick you just stepped on is hollow.

lines.zh: 皮革甲穿旧了才合身，你不懂。
lines.en: Leather only fits once worn; you would not know.

lines.zh: 你还有三步到拐角，我数着呢。
lines.en: Three steps to the corner; I am counting.

lines.zh: 别抬手，抬手我就会先动。
lines.en: Do not raise a hand; I move first if you do.

lines.zh: 皮甲挡了一半，剩下我自己扛。
lines.en: Leather took half; I carry the rest.

lines.zh: 袖子破了，跑起来会灌风。
lines.en: The sleeve tore; wind gets in when I run.

lines.zh: 这一下慢了，得换个角度。
lines.en: That slowed me; I need a new angle.

lines.zh: 铁剑差点掉了，手心出汗。
lines.en: The sword almost slipped; my palm sweats.

lines.zh: 腿还行，能跑。
lines.en: The leg still works; I can run.

lines.zh: 你打得中，是因为我停了一下。
lines.en: You hit me because I paused.

lines.zh: 三道口子变四道，记下了。
lines.en: Three cuts become four; noted.

lines.zh: 别追，我受伤时跑得更快。
lines.en: Do not chase; I run faster when hurt.

lines.zh: 皮甲薄，下次得垫一层布。
lines.en: This leather is thin; next time I pad it with cloth.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，路线不能改。
lines.en: Pain or not, the route stays.

lines.zh: 那块皮革，能补我一双袖。
lines.en: That leather could patch both my sleeves.

lines.zh: 铁锭不错，剑口正缺一块。
lines.en: Iron is welcome; my blade is missing an edge.

lines.zh: 金锭？我背着它跑不快。
lines.en: Gold? I cannot run fast carrying that.

lines.zh: 鞋底的皮，比什么金子都实在。
lines.en: Sole leather is worth more than any gold.

lines.zh: 你把东西放地上，退三步。
lines.en: Set it down and step back three paces.

lines.zh: 那壶油，我留着润剑。
lines.en: That flask of oil goes to my blade.

lines.zh: 肉干好，跑起来不占肚子。
lines.en: Dried meat is good; it rides light in the belly.

lines.zh: 别拿食物晃，我看的是你的手。
lines.en: Do not wave the food; I watch your hand.

lines.zh: 布条给我，脚上缠的散了。
lines.en: Pass the cloth strips; my foot wraps came loose.

lines.zh: 换东西可以，别换时间。
lines.en: Trade goods, but do not trade me time.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你就慢了半步。
lines.en: Bumping me cost you half a step.

lines.zh: 让开，我这条线不能断。
lines.en: Clear the way; my line cannot break.

lines.zh: 皮革甲软，撞了也没什么声音。
lines.en: Leather is soft; the bump barely makes a sound.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的退路，这很危险。
lines.en: You blocked my exit; that is dangerous.

lines.zh: 别抓袖子，扯坏了还得缝。
lines.en: Not the sleeve; tearing it means mending.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记你慢了。
lines.en: Noted: that made you slow.

lines.zh: 贴墙走，别在路中间撞。
lines.en: Hug the wall; do not collide mid-path.

lines.zh: 我轻，撞不疼你，但我记仇。
lines.en: I am light and cannot hurt you, but I remember.

lines.zh: 你的甲太响，离我远点。
lines.en: Your armor rings too loud; keep your distance.

lines.zh: 碰一下就够，别来第二次。
lines.en: One tap is enough; do not try twice.

lines.zh: 两副轻甲，跑起来才不拖对方。
lines.en: Two sets of light armor, so neither slows the other.

lines.zh: 你守东哨，我跑外圈。
lines.en: You keep the east post; I run the outer ring.

lines.zh: 替我缝肩上的口子，我看不见。
lines.en: Mend the tear on my shoulder; I cannot see it.

lines.zh: 报信别跑直线，绕两道。
lines.en: When carrying word, do not run straight; take two turns.

lines.zh: 靴子换着穿，磨得匀。
lines.en: We swap boots so they wear evenly.

lines.zh: 今晚的哨，我去远的那头。
lines.en: Tonight's watch: I take the far end.

lines.zh: 孩子先学听，再学跑。
lines.en: Children learn to listen before they learn to run.

lines.zh: 别把我记的间隔弄乱。
lines.en: Do not scramble the patrol timings I keep.

lines.zh: 你回来时敲两下墙，我就知道。
lines.en: Knock twice on return and I will know.

lines.zh: 轻装的人，牵挂也得分一半。
lines.en: The light-armed still split their worries in half.

lines.zh: 这截皮带，比新的结实。
lines.en: This strap is sturdier than a new one.

lines.zh: 铁片收着，剑口崩了能补。
lines.en: Keep the iron scrap; it patches a chipped edge.

lines.zh: 地上那双旧靴，我试试。
lines.en: Those old boots on the ground; let me try them.

lines.zh: 碎布条，缠脚最好。
lines.en: Rag strips make the best foot wraps.

lines.zh: 谁掉的肉干，我收下了。
lines.en: Someone's dropped jerky; I will take it.

lines.zh: 箭杆还能用，箭头弯了。
lines.en: The shaft is fine; only the head is bent.

lines.zh: 这块皮上有牙印，还能用。
lines.en: This hide has tooth marks; still usable.

lines.zh: 空的油壶也别扔，能装水。
lines.en: Even an empty oil flask holds water.

lines.zh: 捡东西要快，不能停步。
lines.en: Pick it up fast; never break stride.

lines.zh: 那根细绳，正好当绊线。
lines.en: That thin cord makes a fine trip line.

lines.zh: 那个背对走廊的，先记下来。
lines.en: The one with his back to the hall goes on my list.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，那就是破绽。
lines.en: Your steps went uneven; there is the gap.

lines.zh: 我数到你的第七步就动。
lines.en: I move on your seventh step.

lines.zh: 举火把那位，位置最好找。
lines.en: The torchbearer is the easiest to place.

lines.zh: 你换了站位，可影子没换。
lines.en: You changed position; your shadow did not.

lines.zh: 这个人的甲在响，藏不住。
lines.en: His armor rings; he cannot hide.

lines.zh: 从侧缝看过去，你正好在中间。
lines.en: Through the side seam you sit dead center.

lines.zh: 你退向东边，那条路我熟。
lines.en: Retreat east; I know that road well.

lines.zh: 百步之内，我只盯一件事。
lines.en: Within a hundred paces I watch one thing only.

lines.zh: 你数呼吸的时候，我已贴到墙边。
lines.en: While you count breaths, I am already against the wall.

lines.zh: 这个人的靴子是新的，会响。
lines.en: New boots on that one; they will give him away.

lines.zh: 目标定了，路线要两条。
lines.en: Target fixed; I need two routes.

lines.zh: 那个回头看火的，背门大开。
lines.en: The one glancing at the fire leaves his back open.

lines.zh: 你换了路线，脚印还是旧的。
lines.en: You changed routes, but the footprints are old.

lines.zh: 我绕到你影子里，你还没发现。
lines.en: I slide into your shadow before you notice.

lines.zh: 等你的火把往左偏，我就过。
lines.en: When your torch drifts left, I cross.

lines.zh: 你在数砖，我在数你的呼吸。
lines.en: You count bricks; I count your breaths.

lines.zh: 铁剑不重，够快就行。
lines.en: The iron sword is light; quick is enough.

lines.zh: 你的甲缝朝着我，别怪我。
lines.en: Your armor seam faces me; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 退到火盆边，热会让你慢。
lines.en: Retreat to the brazier; heat will slow you.

lines.zh: 我只要一次机会，你也只有一次。
lines.en: I need one opening; you get one too.

lines.zh: 你抬手摸剑，我就先动。
lines.en: Reach for your sword and I move first.

lines.zh: 这条走廊两个拐角，我在第二个。
lines.en: Two corners in this hall; I take the second.

lines.zh: 你的同伴还没到，时间够。
lines.en: Your companion is not here yet; time enough.

lines.zh: 我在听你甲片的节奏。
lines.en: I am listening to the rhythm of your plates.

lines.zh: 别急，快的人先犯错。
lines.en: Do not rush; the quick ones err first.

lines.zh: 我在你第三步的位置等。
lines.en: I wait at the spot where your third step lands.

lines.zh: 你举盾的手会挡视线，正好。
lines.en: That raised shield blocks your own view; perfect.

lines.zh: 一剑刺在甲缝，够浅也够用。
lines.en: One thrust into the seam; shallow works.

lines.zh: 我不劈，劈太慢。
lines.en: I do not chop; chopping is slow.

lines.zh: 刺完就退，别贪第二下。
lines.en: Thrust and withdraw; never chase a second blow.

lines.zh: 铁剑轻，连刺三下才停。
lines.en: The iron sword is light; three thrusts before I stop.

lines.zh: 你的护腕抬得慢，刃就进去了。
lines.en: Your bracer rises late; the edge slips in.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，位置好。
lines.en: Not a heavy blow, but well placed.

lines.zh: 从侧后出手，正面太费力气。
lines.en: I strike from the rear flank; the front costs too much.

lines.zh: 你转身时，我换了个角度。
lines.en: As you turned, I changed the angle.

lines.zh: 皮革甲挡不住铁，这是常识。
lines.en: Leather does not stop iron; common knowledge.

lines.zh: 一击不中就走，别站在原地。
lines.en: Miss and leave; do not stand there.

lines.zh: 我打的是膝盖，不是胸口。
lines.en: I aim at the knee, not the chest.

lines.zh: 快打快收，这是我全部的战术。
lines.en: Strike fast, withdraw fast; that is my whole tactic.

lines.zh: 刺完这一下，我退到柱子后。
lines.en: After this thrust I slip behind the pillar.

lines.zh: 铁剑回收时，刃口朝外。
lines.en: Drawing the iron back, I keep the edge outward.

lines.zh: 我从侧门进来，正门太吵。
lines.en: I came through the side door; the main one is loud.

lines.zh: 靴底刚换，跑得比上次快。
lines.en: New soles today; I run faster than last time.

lines.zh: 这一圈是我先走的，别跟。
lines.en: I take this circuit first; do not follow.

lines.zh: 皮甲三道旧口，都是回来的记号。
lines.en: Three old cuts in this leather, each a return ticket.

lines.zh: 铁剑拔出来没声，你听不到。
lines.en: This iron draws silently; you will not hear it.

lines.zh: 禁堡换哨，我来接外圈。
lines.en: The bastion rotates its watch; I take the outer ring.

lines.zh: 别站在灯下，那位置最先被看见。
lines.en: Do not stand under the lamp; that spot is seen first.

lines.zh: 我跑一趟只要一会儿，你等得住吗。
lines.en: One lap takes me a moment; can you wait?

lines.zh: 报告里会写你站在这里。
lines.en: My report will note you stood right here.

lines.zh: 风往西吹，我的味道传不到你。
lines.en: Wind blows west; my scent never reaches you.

lines.zh: 我从桥下绕上来，砖缝很宽。
lines.en: I came up under the bridge; the seams are wide.

lines.zh: 轻装的人先到，重甲还在后面。
lines.en: The light-armed arrive first; the heavy plate lags behind.

lines.zh: 皮革怕火，这我很清楚。
lines.en: Leather fears fire; I know that well.

lines.zh: 从梁上滑下来，脚踝扭了一下。
lines.en: Slipping off the beam twisted my ankle.

lines.zh: 水进靴子，跑起来像拖石头。
lines.en: Water in my boots runs like dragging stones.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的脚印都抹了。
lines.en: The blast wiped out my footprints.

lines.zh: 箭擦过肩，皮甲正好垫住。
lines.en: The arrow grazed my shoulder; the leather cushioned it.

lines.zh: 咒力锁住脚踝，我动不了。
lines.en: Magic locks my ankle; I cannot move.

lines.zh: 跑太久，肚子先没力气。
lines.en: Run too long and the belly gives out first.

lines.zh: 雷落在身边，我耳朵嗡了半天。
lines.en: Lightning struck nearby and my ears rang for ages.

lines.zh: 掉下去时，我还在找落脚的砖。
lines.en: Falling, I still look for a brick to land on.
